items.title: Ralph Sutton interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 22, 1995
items.q: That’s right. Yeah, I’ve loved Fats from the beginning of my musical experience when I started at nine and he’ll be with me until I’m gone.

ctx.x: Now I know Fats Waller was an influence on your playing, is that a fair statement?
That’s right. Yeah, I’ve loved Fats from the beginning of my musical experience when I started at nine and he’ll be with me until I’m gone.
He wrote some great tunes too.
